description: Pages through the source app's records (read only) into NDJSON objects in the customer's R2 bucket. Resumable: progress is saved after every page, so a stopped run continues where it stopped. Each call does a bounded slice and returns status partial until every type is done; call it again. Pass since for a delta run that exports only records modified after that time. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

cf_api_token.description: A Cloudflare API token with D1 edit permission on that account. Sealed in the job, deleted when it ends. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

data_api_token.description: The source app's Data API token. Needed on the first call; sealed in the job. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

go_ahead.description: Set true only when a charge applies, once the owner has seen the estimate and agreed to it. Not needed under the free trial or a pass that already covers the app. Needed again after a pass has expired.

max_pages.description: Pages of up to 100 records per call. Default 20.

max_requests_per_minute.description: Throttle for the source app. Default 60.

r2_access_key_id.description: Access key id of an R2 API token that can read and write that bucket. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

r2_bucket.description: An R2 bucket in that account, for staging and schema files.

r2_secret_access_key.description: Its secret. Sealed in the job, deleted when it ends. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

reexport.description: Export everything again even though a finished run exists.

since.description: ISO date. Only records modified after it (a delta run). Starts a new run once the previous one is done.

types.description: Data type keys to export. Default: every type not skipped in the plan.

upgrade.description: Set true to pay the difference to the next pass that fits, only when the app is past its pass's (or free trial's) record or file limit.

name: nc_export
title: Export records to R2 staging (paid)
